mods.name: 津仔的交通灯
mods.description:
JINZAI Traffic Lights 2.1.50 adds 73 blocks and replaces 44 frame models while preserving all 261 previous registry IDs. There are 334 blocks in four creative tabs: 89 frames, 108 indicators, 117 poles and 20 accessories. All 37 animated signals use synchronized vanilla texture animation; the six new strips each contain 144 frames at 10 ticks per frame (72 seconds). New and replaced models use one bounding box enclosing the placed volume. Indicators and accessories have no physical collision. The new cylindrical camera emits light; the five other new accessories do not. Older lighting behavior is preserved. These are decorative blocks without independent timers or redstone traffic control. Art and funding by Crzay津仔; technical implementation by QiZhang. Original project code and art use the MIT License; third-party components retain their licenses.

releases.notes:
津仔的交通灯更新至 **2.1.50**。六期按实际素材新增 **73 个方块**、替换 **44 个旧框架模型**，共 **334 个方块**，四端内容同步。

- 新增：24 个框架、14 个指示灯、29 个杆件、6 个附属。
- 新增 6 组动画，每组 144 帧、每帧 10 tick、72 秒循环；动态贴图共 37 组。
- 本期 117 个新增或替换模型采用整体外包箱；指示灯和附属保持无物理碰撞。
- 保留全部 261 个旧注册 ID、13 种语言和四个创造分类，修复 r10c 物品图标偏移。

### 安装

只安装对应 Minecraft 版本和加载器的一份 JAR，替换旧版。依赖需另行安装。

| Minecraft | 加载器（实测版本） | Java | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.20.1 | Fabric Loader 0.17.2 | 17 | Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1；Architectury API 9.2.14 |
| 1.20.1 | Forge 47.4.23 | 17 | Architectury API 9.2.14 |
| 1.21.1 | Fabric Loader 0.17.2 | 21 | Fabric API 0.116.15+1.21.1；Architectury API 13.0.8 |
| 1.21.1 | NeoForge 21.1.248 | 21 | Architectury API 13.0.8 |

### 文件与源码

附件提供四个 JAR、纯净源码 ZIP、INSTALLATION.md、117 项更新清单 UPDATE_BLOCKS.csv 和 SHA256SUMS.txt。
源码包含根目录的 1.20.1 工程及 versions/1.21.1 工程，分别使用 JDK 17、JDK 21 构建。公开资源生成和校验仅需 Python 3.11+ 标准库，无需私有表格。

### 验证范围

发布 JAR 与本次交付的已测文件逐字节一致。四个最终 2.1.50 JAR 均完成实际加载身份核验、r10c 图标复测并正常退出；NeoForge 补验 c1 正面模型。
未变更的模型、碰撞和动画，通过新旧 JAR 严格差异核对后沿用此前四端实机证据；本次没有重新采集全量动画。动画严格连续核验窗口分别约为 123 秒、159.75 秒、115 秒、84.25 秒，均覆盖至少一个 72 秒循环；NeoForge 原完整记录存在 14 个跳过采样点。
验证限于指定依赖下的隔离单人环境，不代表多人联机、整合包兼容、长期稳定性或 FPS 性能认证。

### 素材与许可

客户提供的 white_pole_13（白色粗圆杆－顶部）与 white_pole_12（底部半砖）模型和贴图相同，目前按原素材保留两个 ID。
本项目自身代码和素材采用 MIT 许可证，第三方依赖保留各自许可证。美术与资金支持：Crzay津仔；技术实现：QiZhang。

mods.name: 津仔的交通灯
mods.description:
JINZAI Traffic Lights 2.0.46 adds 11 height-restriction pole components and 16 animated indicators to Minecraft 1.20.1, preserving all 234 previous blocks. The mod now contains 261 blocks: 65 frames, 94 indicators, 88 poles and 14 accessories in four creative tabs. All 31 animated signals use synchronized 2 FPS texture animation; each of the 16 new strips has 144 frames and a 72-second loop. New models use one bounding box enclosing their placed volume. Indicators and accessories remain illuminated and physically pass-through. These are decorative blocks without independent timers, traffic-control logic or redstone signal control. Art and funding by Crzay津仔; technical implementation and production by QiZhang. Original project code and art use the MIT License; third-party components retain their licenses.

# JINZAI Traffic Lights 2.0.46

新增五期27个方块（11个限高杆件、16个动态指示灯），合计261个方块、31组动画，并同步提供Minecraft 1.21.1的Fabric与NeoForge版本。四端内容及模组版本一致，图标使用客户原图转换的PNG。

## 安装

仅选择匹配Minecraft版本和加载器的一份JAR，移除旧版本后放入mods。依赖需另行安装。

| Minecraft | 加载器（实测版本） | Java | 另需安装 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.20.1 | Fabric Loader 0.17.2 | 17 | Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1；Architectury API 9.2.14 |
| 1.20.1 | Forge 47.4.23 | 17 | Architectury API 9.2.14 |
| 1.21.1 | Fabric Loader 0.17.2 | 21 | Fabric API 0.116.15+1.21.1；Architectury API 13.0.8 |
| 1.21.1 | NeoForge 21.1.248 | 21 | Architectury API 13.0.8 |

不要混装加载器或Minecraft版本不同的JAR。Architectury兼容范围：1.20.1使用9.0.6至低于10.0.0；1.21.1使用13.0.8至低于14.0.0。所有模型、名称及旧注册ID保持兼容；街道设施不在本次更新范围。

## 源码与许可

纯净源码ZIP包含仓库根目录的1.20.1工程及versions/1.21.1子工程。分别使用JDK17和JDK21运行各自的Gradle Wrapper执行clean build。请完整解压，1.21.1子工程需要根目录公共资源和LICENSE。源码包保留原始美术与构建所需生成资源，排除私有工作表、客户说明文档、日志、缓存和构建产物。

项目自身代码及素材采用MIT许可证，第三方依赖保留各自许可证。美术与资金支持：Crzay津仔；技术实现：QiZhang。

## 验证范围

发布JAR与2026-10-11实机复检交付逐字节一致。四端各完成261模型的522张双视角近景、27个新增物品图标、31组动画完整循环核验，并正常退出。源素材静态检查覆盖2883动画帧。本次公开源码ZIP另经重新解压构建校验。

每端约160秒动画采样中，1.20.1 Forge有10次采样跳槽与初始亮度稳定过程，1.21.1 Fabric有少数切换边界时序偏差；分别以连续104.766秒和84.754秒稳定片段确认完整循环。此验证限于指定依赖下的本地单机画面，不代表全程无停顿、多人联机、长期稳定性或性能认证。客户原模型已有的细小色边、杆件拼缝保持原样。

动画沿用原版同步装饰贴图，不包含独立倒计时或红石交通控制。新16组动画每组144帧、每帧10 tick、循环72秒。

SHA256SUMS.txt包含四个JAR、源码ZIP和本说明的SHA-256校验值。

mods.name: 津仔的交通灯
mods.description:
JINZAI Traffic Lights is a Minecraft 1.20.1 city-building decoration mod for Fabric and Forge, sharing one Architectury codebase. Version 2.0.45 preserves all 213 existing registry IDs and adds all 21 phase-four blocks, for 234 total: 65 frames, 78 indicators, 77 poles and 14 pass-through accessories in the four existing creative tabs. Every new model and the three replaced frames use one bounding box enclosing the placed model volume; unchanged older models retain their collision behavior. The 15 synchronized animated signals remain at 2 FPS, with interpolation disabled for the first two. Indicators and accessories remain illuminated and physically pass-through. Independent timers, functional countdowns, traffic-control logic and redstone signal control are not included. Art and funding by Crzay津仔; technical implementation and production by QiZhang. Original project code, configuration, documentation, models, textures and artwork use the MIT License; third-party components retain their own licenses.

# 2.0.45 — 2026-10-01

Minecraft 1.20.1 · Fabric / Forge · Java 17 · MIT

## 更新内容

- 新增四期全部 21 个方块：6 个框架、6 个指示灯、5 个杆件、4 个附属，总计 234 个方块，沿用原有四个创造模式分类。
- 更新 c5、h30、h31 框架模型及 c5 贴图，保留全部旧注册 ID 和名称。
- 新增方块和上述三个替换模型使用覆盖放置后完整体积的单一外包箱；指示灯与附属维持原有无物理碰撞行为。
- 动态灯 1、2 关闭帧间插值；15 组动态贴图保留客户素材、帧次序与每帧 10 tick 的播放速度。
- 修复 26 个旧物品图标过大、跨格显示的问题，仅调整物品栏显示变换。
- 本项目自身代码、文档、模型及贴图统一采用 MIT 许可证，保留原有版权归属和署名。

## 校验范围

234 套模型和贴图、936 个方向状态、15 组动画的 579 帧静态检查通过。Fabric 与 Forge 单人客户端均完成全量方块放置、修复图标显示检查；每端连续观察全部 15 组动画 70 秒、采样 350 张画面，状态与源素材序列匹配。两个客户端正常退出，未发现本模组的模型或贴图资源错误。

这不包含专用服务器多人联机、长期性能测试或逐一人工检查模型的每个观察角度。

## 安装

从本次 Release 选择对应加载器的 JAR，替换旧版本；不要混装 Fabric 与 Forge 文件。

- Fabric 测试环境：Loader 0.17.2、Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1、Architectury API 9.2.14。
- Forge 测试环境：Forge 47.4.23、Architectury API 9.2.14。
- 依赖需另行安装。Release 同时提供纯净源码 ZIP 和 SHA-256 清单；源码包含构建所需的生成资源及原始美术，排除私有工作表、日志、缓存和构建产物。

releases.notes:
# JINZAI Traffic Lights 2.0.41

## English

This is the Minecraft 1.20.1 Architectury release for both Fabric and Forge. Version 2.0.41 is the bug-fix release following the phase-three 2.0.4 feature line.

- Retains all 161 phase-one and phase-two blocks and adds 52 phase-three blocks, for 213 blocks total.
- Adds 15 synchronized decorative animated indicators at 2 FPS.
- Uses one enclosing placed-volume outline for new non-pole models and reduced model-following outlines for new poles to improve targeting and placement performance.
- Provides 13 languages and exactly four creative tabs.
- Includes the Fabric JAR, Forge JAR, curated Architectury source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums.

Dependencies: Minecraft 1.20.1, Java 17 or newer, and Architectury API 9.0.6 through versions earlier than 10.0.0. Fabric also requires Fabric Loader 0.17.2 or newer and Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1 or a newer compatible 1.20.1 build. Forge requires a compatible Forge 47.x build.

Remove older copies of this mod before installing this release. Install only the JAR matching the selected loader.

## 中文

这是面向 Minecraft 1.20.1、通过同一套 Architectury 源码构建的 Fabric 与 Forge 双版本。2.0.41 是三期 2.0.4 功能版本线之后的 BUG 修复版本。

- 完整保留一期与二期共161个方块，新增三期52个方块，总计213个。
- 新增15个以2 FPS同步播放的装饰性动态指示灯。
- 新增非杆件模型使用覆盖放置后整体体积的单一外包箱；新增杆件使用适度简化的模型跟随轮廓，以改善准星选中和侧边放置时的性能。
- 提供13种语言，并保持恰好4个创造标签页。
- 附件包含Fabric JAR、Forge JAR、整理后的Architectury源码ZIP及SHA-256校验表。

前置要求：Minecraft 1.20.1、Java 17或更高版本、Architectury API 9.0.6至低于10.0.0的版本。Fabric还需要Fabric Loader 0.17.2或更高版本，以及Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1或更新的1.20.1兼容版本；Forge需要兼容的Forge 47.x版本。

安装前请移除本模组旧版本，并且只安装与当前加载器对应的一个JAR。

JINZAI Traffic Lights is a Minecraft 1.20.1 decorative expansion mod for city building, available for Fabric and Forge through a shared Architectury codebase. Version 2.0.33 retains all 103 phase-one blocks and all 58 phase-two models, for 161 freely combinable blocks in total: 48 traffic-light frame and frame-component blocks, 55 static indicator and decorative lighting blocks, 48 pole and pole-component blocks, and 10 illuminated, pass-through traffic-light accessory decorations. Ten complex traffic-light models use one enclosing box matching each complete placed model volume for their selection and physical collision; the other 151 blocks retain their previous collision behavior. The 10 accessory blocks appear in their own creative-mode tab named Traffic Light Accessories; all other additions remain in the existing category tabs. Dynamic traffic lights, countdowns, automatic cycling and customizable signal control are not included. Art and funding by Crzay津仔; technical implementation and production by QiZhang. ## English

JINZAI Traffic Lights 2.0.33 is the first shared Architectury release for Minecraft 1.20.1, providing separate Fabric and Forge JARs from one synchronized codebase.

- Retains all 161 decorative blocks and the registry/resource baseline from Fabric 1.0.32.
- Includes 13 game-language localizations and the new traffic-light icon.
- Keeps the optimized enclosing collision boxes for the 10 previously identified complex models.
- Items display localized names only, without additional tooltip notes.
- The public source ZIP retains the code, build configuration, original editable art, icon source artwork and pre-generated runtime resources. Private non-build documents and workbooks are excluded.

Requirements:

- Minecraft 1.20.1 and Java 17 or newer.
- Fabric: Fabric Loader, Fabric API 0.92.6+1.20.1, and Architectury API `>=9.0.6 <10.0.0`.
- Forge: Forge 47.x and Architectury API `>=9.0.6 <10.0.0`.
- Architectury API 9.2.14 is the verified recommended version.

Install only the JAR for your loader and remove older copies first. Because 2.0.33 restructures the project into Architectury modules, back up the world before replacing an older build.

Published author: **Crzay津仔**. Full production credit and copyright information are recorded in `README.md` and `COPYRIGHT.txt`. The repository `LICENSE` remains unchanged.
